challenger_P1_mean_anchor.declared_before: any replay metric of an alpha = 0 arm
challenger_P1_mean_anchor.defect: JM1 production scorer uses mean anchor alpha = 1 (no anchor): PMF mean = mu_1B x E_d[exp(b0 + c log(M/min_mu) + env)]. With minutes elasticity c > 1 (PTS 1.30, FG3M 1.37, REB 1.08, AST 1.07) the Jensen term grows with minutes CV^2; the GLM intercept absorbs only the population average (starter dominated). Live 2026-27 incumbent PMFs, PTS: PMF/marginal 1.121 (min_mu 5-10) vs analytic E[(M/mu)^c] 1.106; 1.064 vs 1.057 (10-15); 1.00 for 25+. Realized/PMF PTS 0.77 (5-10), FG3M 0.73.
challenger_P1_mean_anchor.fix: MNA: lm_ib = lm_full_ib + s_i, s_i = log E_d[exp(lm_nominutes_ib)] - log E_d[exp(lm_full_ib)], where lm_nominutes uses the same draws and every JM1 term except log_minutes_ratio. E_d[mu] then equals the JM1 mean without the minutes-convexity (Jensen) term; the intercept, environment context, per-draw minutes variation and residual dependence are unchanged. No parameter fitted, no probability scaling.

challenger_R1_injury_replacement.diagnosis_LIVE: oos_2027: 340 absences of min_mu>=25 players. 221 KNOWN (p_play<0.5), all ONGOING (missed the team's previous game); teammates' realized/forecast minutes 0.996-1.084 (unbiased: recent-form features already carry the redistribution). 119 SURPRISE (p_play>=0.5, DNP; all first-game outs): teammates +2.98/+1.33/+1.64/+1.15 min (tiers <10/10-20/20-25/25+) vs NONE +0.07/-0.37/+1.29/-0.66; PTS realized/forecast 1.15/1.01/1.18/1.11. Zero KNOWN_NEW cases live.
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.trigger: team-game with >=1 NEW absence: LIVE = min_mu>=25 & p_play>=0.5 & DNP; history (played rows only) = last-3 mean minutes>=25, played the team's previous game, no row this game.
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.lost_minutes: L = sum over new absentees of their conditional minutes forecast (LIVE min_mu; history: min_mu of the absentee's most recent row).

challenger_R1_injury_replacement.cap: min_mu_i + dmin_i <= 40; P(play) unchanged (live: teammates' played share unchanged by a shock)
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.fit: beta by least squares on teammate (y_min - min_mu) in F2025 trigger team-games; arm chosen on F2025 MSE; F2026 = confirmation; LIVE SURPRISE = single final evaluation, no refit.
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.gate: LIVE: teammate minutes MSE R1 - INC, game-clustered 95% ub < 0, and |bias| reduced in >=3 of 4 tiers; F2026 MSE also improves (ub < 0).
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.if_pass: implement in prod.inputs as a mean-only minutes adjustment for confirmed-OUT new absentees (availability known at scoring); the stat PMFs follow through the frozen minutes elasticity; rotation-shock games stay non-actionable until the prospective gate.
challenger_R1_injury_replacement.policy_ongoing: separately: an OUT player whose own p_play < 0.5 (model already expects the absence) is evidenced as represented (ratio 0.996-1.084); UNSUPPORTED_ROTATION_SHOCK narrowed to OUT players with p_play >= 0.5 only if the LIVE KNOWN_ONGOING teammate bias is within 2 se of NONE in every tier.

result.classification: the history trigger (roster inference, absentee unknown to the forecast) overstates the live new-OUT effect: live incremental teammate minutes vs the no-shock baseline are ~+2.9/+1.7/+0.4/+1.8, beta*share adds ~+1.6..+3.2 in tiers 10+. Live sample (112 team-games) too small to fit. Production keeps the fail-closed UNSUPPORTED_ROTATION_SHOCK for new outs (no wrong price is actionable).
